thread:
Carmen: Kickoff: Prospect 'Abyss' wants a staged migration off CompetitorQ. Must be minimal SDK changes, template/prompt-slot parity, transparent token billing mapping, and a pen-test window for on-prem fallback. Who's on this?
Eli: Quick clarify — do they need exact HTTP path parity or just that client calls don't change? Sales said 'minimal changes', leaning toward behavior parity not exact path.
Rohan: Eng risks: tokenizer differences (slots can split differently), stop-token semantics, sampling defaults, and their clients use a custom dedupe header X-Repeat-ID. Also they count tokens differently for templated prompts -> billing deltas.
Priya: For template parity we can provide a small client helper that normalizes variables (e.g., {{user.name}} -> a single token-safe placeholder) and run a pre-tokenize pass to minimize splits. Also propose a server-side template-normalization shim on staging.
Carmen: Billing question — they want a reconciliation report that maps CompetitorQ token CSV -> our billing units. Can we produce sample script and expected variance?
Eli: Yes — script will: (1) apply same normalization, (2) re-tokenize with both tokenizers, (3) emit a mapping CSV and a delta summary. Expect typical variance 5-18% depending on template density. We'll include a configurable token mapping table to tighten that.
deploy-bot: Presales env queued: abyss-template-shim v0.1 -> staging (job 12999). CI checks passing.
Priya: Pen-test window: on-prem fallback customers get a 48-72h window for customer-led pentest on dedicated infra. We need to schedule with infra and provide a snapshot of logs + audit export format.
audit-bot: Security questionnaire flag: request for VPC peering details, HSM support, list of exported audit fields, and SOC2 evidence. Ticket created: sec-abyss-pt.
Carmen: Proposed POC acceptance criteria: 1) Top-1 intent/slot parity >=94% on their template eval set; 2) reconciled billing variance <=12% after normalization; 3) p95 latency within 30% of CompetitorQ under their traffic profile; 4) pen-test slot scheduled and confirmed. Target timeline: 10 business days.
Rohan: 10 days doable if we get eval set, sample billing CSV, API key for CompetitorQ baseline, and allowlist IPs by start-of-week Monday. I'll run baseline sampling and a small calibration to map stop-token behavior.
Eli: Smoke test curl for shim (share with customer):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/v1/abyss-shim/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Repeat-ID: 7a2d" \
  -d '{"template":"Dear {{user.name}}, your balance is {{balance}}","max_tokens":60}'
```
Priya: I'll upload SOC2 excerpt, HSM notes, and audit export sample to presales folder and ping infra about pentest scheduling.
Carmen: Action items: Rohan -> baseline runs + parity report; Eli -> reconciliation script + sample CSV; Priya -> security docs + pentest scheduling; Carmen -> confirm eval set + commercial addendum (no-training + retention).
Eli: I'll stub the token-map example and post to the presales doc.
Carmen: Great. Marking thread presales-abyss-template for follow-up.
